notes.title: Update 4
notes.content:
Some people were reporting that the game would not load after pulling the trigger on the splash screen - hopefully this fixes that issue.
Please let me know in the discussion board if you are unable to load the game after this update.

notes.title: Update 3
notes.content: This update just adds back the skin cell which was accidentally removed in the previous update.

notes.title: 2nd Update!
notes.content:
Did you know that if you placed all the planets in our solar system end-to-end, they would just barely fit in between the Earth and our moon? See for yourself with this latest update!

Also, you might think our sun is big at 1.39 million kilometers in diameter, but it's absolutely dwarfed by many other stars in our galaxy. This update lets you see just how much more massive they are!

notes.title: First Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34333141/51c4ecff812c29e3bfa85b79d81530ab5da00dd3.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Features[h1]
[list]
[*] Added a toggle to the left controller menu for hiding/showing labels
[*] Added toggles to the left controller menu for hiding/showing the three different types of scale cubes.
[*] Shortened the controller tooltip text.
[*] Made the electron field spin faster
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the unresponsive controller menu in the main scene
[/list]
